## 0. Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# ---- Clear the environment ----
rm(list=ls())

# ---- Load libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(FSA)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(rlang)
library(rstudioapi)

# ---- File paths ----
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
input_path   <- file.path(current_path, "../data/processed/s18_microbial/otu_tables")
output_path  <- file.path(current_path, "../output/alpha_diversity")

# ---- Plot settings ----
source(file.path(current_path, "plotting_aesthetics.R")) # Loads theme_wali()
```


## 1. Load & tidy phyloseq data
```{r}
# ---- Load normalized otu tables ----
count_m <- data.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(
    input_path,"s18_otu_rarefied_count_table.csv"), row.names = 1) # Count table
  )
tax_m <- as.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(
    input_path,"s18_otu_rarefied_tax_table.csv"), row.names = 1) # Taxonomy table
  )
meta <- read.csv(file.path(
  input_path,"s18_otu_rarefied_sample_data.csv"), row.names = 1) # Sample data

# ---- Create phyloseq object ----
ps_count_norm <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(count_m, taxa_are_rows = T), 
  tax_table(tax_m),
  sample_data(meta))
ps_count_norm

# ---- Variable lists ----
dm     <- c("09 Jul","16 Jul","23 Jul","30 Jul","06 Aug")
stage  <- c("Pre","Storm","Post")
stage2 <- c("Pre","Storm", "Post1w", "Post2w")
site   <- c("P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P9","P10","OM2")
region <- c("Kahawai","Mauka","Makai")

# ---- Format levels ----
ps_count_norm@sam_data$DM     <- factor(ps_count_norm@sam_data$DM, levels = dm)
ps_count_norm@sam_data$Stage  <- factor(ps_count_norm@sam_data$Stage, levels = stage)
ps_count_norm@sam_data$Stage2 <- factor(ps_count_norm@sam_data$Stage2, levels = stage2)
ps_count_norm@sam_data$Site   <- factor(ps_count_norm@sam_data$Site, levels = site)
ps_count_norm@sam_data$Region <- factor(ps_count_norm@sam_data$Region, levels = region)
```

## 1. Calculate alpha diversity
```{r}
# ---- Standard alpha diversity (Observed, Chao1, Shannon, Simpson, InvSimpson) ----
alpha <- estimate_richness(ps_count_norm, split = TRUE, measures = NULL)

# ---- Rarefied count matrix (samples as rows) for Hill numbers ----
otu_m <- as(otu_table(ps_count_norm), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_count_norm)) otu_m <- t(otu_m)   # renyi() expects sites = rows

# ---- Taxonomic Hill numbers: 0D, 1D, 2D (Chao, Chiu & Jost 2014) ----
hill <- vegan::renyi(otu_m, scales = c(0, 1, 2), hill = TRUE)
alpha$q0_D <- hill[["0"]]   # richness     (= Observed)
alpha$q1_D <- hill[["1"]]   # exp(Shannon)
alpha$q2_D <- hill[["2"]]   # inverse Simpson

# ---- Pielou's evenness: J' = Shannon / log(richness) = log(1D) / log(0D) ----
alpha$Pielou_J <- log(alpha$q1_D) / log(alpha$q0_D)

# ---- Merge with sample data ----
alpha_df <- cbind(
  alpha, ps_count_norm@sam_data)
alpha_df # Preview

# ---- Save alpha diversity (all metrics) ----
write.csv(data.frame(sample_data(alpha_df)), file.path(input_path,"../post_processing/s18_alpha_diversity.csv"))
```


## 2. Calculate stats
```{r}
# ---- Main function ----
plot_alpha <- function(metric, title, y.position, y.lab = title) {

  # Wrangle
  df <- alpha_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Desc_Sample_ID, DM, Value = !!sym(metric))

  # Summary statistics
  res <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(DM) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(stat = paste(round(mean(Value), 2), "±", round(sd(Value), 2))) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = DM, values_from = stat)

  # Kruskal-Wallis (omnibus)
  kw <- kruskal.test(Value ~ DM, data = df)
  kw_row <- res %>%
    mutate(Metric = metric, H = round(kw$statistic, 1), p = round(kw$p.value, 4)) %>%
    relocate(Metric)

  # Dunn's post-hoc on the joint KW ranking, Benjamini-Hochberg corrected
    dunn <- dunnTest(Value ~ DM, data = df, method = "bh")$res
  lev  <- levels(df$DM)
  pc <- dunn %>%
    tidyr::separate(Comparison, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ") %>%
    mutate(metric = title, p = round(P.adj, 4),
           p.sign = symnum(P.adj, cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 1),
                           symbols = c("***", "**", "*", ".", "ns"))) %>%
    # stack by horizontal position: left-anchored lowest, rising to the right
    arrange(pmin(match(group1, lev), match(group2, lev)),
            pmax(match(group1, lev), match(group2, lev))) %>%
    select(metric, group1, group2, p, p.sign)

  # Highlight band for storm date
  storm_x <- as.numeric(df$DM[df$DM == "23 Jul"][[1]])

  # Plot
  plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = DM, y = Value)) +
    geom_rect(xmin = storm_x - 0.5, xmax = storm_x + 0.5,
              ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#dfdfdf") +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_boxplot(notch = FALSE, width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5) +
    labs(x = "Date", y = y.lab) +
    theme_wali()

  sig <- pc[pc$p <= 0.05, ]
  if (kw$p.value <= 0.05 && nrow(sig) > 0) {
    plot <- plot + stat_pvalue_manual(
      sig, step.increase = 0.1,
      y.position = y.position, label = "p.sign", vjust = 0.65)
  }

  list(plot = plot, kw = as.data.frame(kw_row), dunn = pc)
}

# ---- Generate plots and collect stats ----
metrics <- list(
  # ---- Standard alpha diversity (Observed, Chao1, Shannon, Simpson, InvSimpson) ----
  list(metric = "Observed",   title = "No. OTUs Observed",  y.position = 225),
  list(metric = "Chao1",      title = "Chao1",               y.position = 225),
  list(metric = "Shannon",    title = "Shannon Index",       y.position = 4.65),
  list(metric = "Simpson",    title = "Simpson Index",       y.position = 1),
  list(metric = "InvSimpson", title = "InvSimpson Index",    y.position = 52),
  # ---- Hill numbers + Pielou's evenness ----
  list(metric = "q0_D",     title = "0D Richness",     y.position = 225,
       y.lab = expression(bold(""^0)*bolditalic(D))),
  list(metric = "q1_D",     title = "1D exp(Shannon)", y.position = 97,
       y.lab = expression(bold(""^1)*bolditalic(D))),
  list(metric = "q2_D",     title = "2D InvSimpson",   y.position = 52,
       y.lab = expression(bold(""^2)*bolditalic(D))),
  list(metric = "Pielou_J", title = "Pielou's J'",     y.position = 0.88,
       y.lab = expression(paste(bold("Pielou's "), bolditalic(J), bold("'"))))
  ); results <- lapply(metrics, function(m) do.call(plot_alpha, m))
```

## 3. Save plots
```{r}
# ---- Extract plots ----
(obs_plot  <- results[[1]]$plot)
(chao_plot <- results[[2]]$plot)
(shan_plot <- results[[3]]$plot)
(simp_plot <- results[[4]]$plot)
(invs_plot <- results[[5]]$plot)
(q0_plot   <- results[[6]]$plot)   # 0D richness
(q1_plot   <- results[[7]]$plot)   # 1D exp(Shannon)
(q2_plot   <- results[[8]]$plot)   # 2D inverse Simpson
(piel_plot <- results[[9]]$plot)   # Pielou's J'

# ---- Export plots to file ----
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_observed.pdf"), obs_plot,  width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_chao1.pdf"),    chao_plot, width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_shannon.pdf"),  shan_plot, width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_simpson.pdf"),  simp_plot, width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_invsimp.pdf"),  invs_plot, width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_q0.pdf"),       q0_plot,   width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_q1.pdf"),       q1_plot,   width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_q2.pdf"),       q2_plot,   width = 3, height = 4)
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_pielou.pdf"),   piel_plot, width = 3, height = 4)

# ---- Save ggplot objects ----
saveRDS(q0_plot,   file.path(output_path, "../figure_6_s18_alpha_beta/components/A_q0_plot.rds"))
saveRDS(q1_plot,   file.path(output_path, "../figure_6_s18_alpha_beta/components/A_q1_plot.rds"))
saveRDS(q2_plot,   file.path(output_path, "../figure_6_s18_alpha_beta/components/A_q2_plot.rds"))

ggarrange(
  q0_plot,
  q1_plot,
  q2_plot,
  ncol = 3,
  labels = c("A","B","C")
)
```
**Figure 4A-C.Alpha diversity expressed as Hill number:** where (A) ⁰D, OTU richness; (B) ¹D, the exponential of Shannon entropy; and (C) ²D, the inverse Simpson concentration. Grey shading marks the storm-period sampling date (23 July).Brackets denote significant pairwise differences in Dunn's post-hoc comparisons between dates (* p < 0.05, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001).


## 4. Save summary tables
```{r}
# ---- Extract summary tables ----
(alpha_kw   <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "kw")))
(alpha_dunn <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "dunn")))

# ---- Export tables to file ----
write.csv(alpha_kw,   file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_test_kruskal.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(alpha_dunn, file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_test_dunnoxon.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Calculate percent change ----
pct_change <- bind_rows(lapply(results, function(r) {
  df <- alpha_df %>%
    dplyr::select(DM, Value = !!sym(r$kw$Metric))
  
  pre   <- mean(df$Value[df$DM %in% c("09 Jul", "16 Jul")])
  storm <- mean(df$Value[df$DM == "23 Jul"])
  post  <- mean(df$Value[df$DM %in% c("30 Jul", "06 Aug")])
  
  data.frame(
    Metric          = r$kw$Metric,
    Pre_storm_mean  = round(pre, 3),
    Storm_mean      = round(storm, 3),
    Post_storm_mean = round(post, 3),
    Pct_pre_to_storm  = round((storm - pre) / pre * 100, 1),
    Pct_storm_to_post = round((post - storm) / storm * 100, 1)
  )
}))
pct_change

# ---- Export percent change ----
write.csv(pct_change, file.path(output_path,"s18_alpha_pct_change.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
